```{r setup, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidyfinance)
library(scales)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggcorrplot)
```

```{r}
prices <- download_data(type = "stock_prices",
                         symbols = c("AAPL","NVDA", "MSFT", "BRK-B", "JPM", "V", "CAT", "GE", "RTX", "AMZN", "TSLA", "HD", "LLY", "JNJ", "ABBV", "GOOG", "META", "NFLX", "WMT", "COST", "PG", "XOM", "CVX", "COP", "LIN", "NEM", "FCX", "NEE", "SO", "DUK", "WELL", "PLD", "EQIX"),
                         start_date = "2016-01-01",
                         end_date = "2026-04-20")
  
```


```{r}
returns <- prices %>% 
  group_by(symbol) %>% 
  arrange(date) %>% 
  mutate(dailyret = log(adjusted_close/lag(adjusted_close))) %>% 
  select(symbol, date, dailyret) %>% 
  drop_na(dailyret)

```

```{r}
subset_returns <- returns %>% 
  filter(symbol %in% c("NVDA", "BRK-B", "AMZN", "LLY", "GOOG", "CAT"))

subset_returns %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = dailyret)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 100,
                 fill = "steelblue") +
  facet_wrap(~symbol, scales = "free") +
  labs(title = "Histogram over daily returns for AMZN, BRK-B, GOOG, LLY, and NVDA",
       x = "Return",
       y = "Frequency") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
subset_returns %>% 
  ggplot(aes(sample = dailyret)) +
  stat_qq() +
  stat_qq_line(color = "red") +
  facet_wrap(~symbol, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    x = "Theoretical quantiles",
    y = "Sample quantiles"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```




```{r}
assets <- returns %>% 
  group_by(symbol) %>% 
  summarize(mu = mean(dailyret),
            sd = sd(dailyret))
```

```{r}
assets %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = sd,
             y = mu,
             label = symbol)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text_repel() +
  labs(x = "Volatility",
       y = "Expected return",
       title = "Expected returns and standard deviation of selected assets") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
returns_wide <- returns %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = symbol,
              values_from = dailyret)

sigma_c <- returns_wide %>% 
  select(-date) %>% 
  cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

sigma_c %>% 
ggcorrplot(
  type = "upper",
  hc.order = TRUE,
  outline.color = "white",
  colors = c("blue", "white", "red"),
  show.diag = TRUE) +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
  theme(
  axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 10),
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10)) 
```

**Markowitz:**

*Weighs for the minimum variance portfolio*

```{r}
sigma <- returns_wide %>% 
  select(-date) %>% 
  cov()

u <- rep(1, dim(sigma)[1])
sigma_inv <- solve(sigma)
x_MIN <- as.vector(sigma_inv %*% u) / as.numeric(u %*% sigma_inv %*% u)
```


```{r}
assets <- assets %>% 
  mutate(x_MIN = x_MIN)

assets %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = x_MIN,
             y = fct_reorder(symbol, x_MIN),
             fill = x_MIN > 0)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent) +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = NULL,
       title = "Portfolio weights for minimum variance") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
We denote $\overline{R}$ by $\mu$ in what follows.
```{r}
mu <- assets$mu

z_star <- sigma_inv %*% mu -
  (as.numeric(u %*% sigma_inv %*% mu) /
   as.numeric(u %*% sigma_inv %*% u)) *
  sigma_inv %*% u

assets <- assets %>% 
  mutate(z_star = z_star)
assets %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = z_star,
             y = fct_reorder(symbol, z_star),
             fill = z_star > 0)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = NULL,
       title = "Portfolio weights for z* portfolio") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
